description: A dim, painterly interior of a stone medieval hall with pointed arches and shafts of light from high windows. A young woman with short dark hair, in a dark tunic and wrists in chains, stands centre-right in a beam of light. On the left, clerics in black hooded robes sit at a wooden table with open books, scrolls, a quill and an inkwell, and one points. An armoured soldier stands at the right edge among onlookers. No visible text, frame or border.
